name: coding-agent
title: Coding Agent
description: A coding agent workspace template: sessions in a tab strip or a project sidebar, each with a chat transcript, a resizable side panel for reviewing diffs, reading files, previewing the app, following the session's other agents and its shared tasks, and a terminal dock. Sub-agents, orchestrator/worker runs and messages between agents show in the transcript, and sessions flag when any of their agents needs an answer.

docs: Import: `import { CodingAgent, CODING_AGENT_DEMO, createHarnessStore } from '@/components/ui/coding-agent'`. Pass your own `data`, handle side effects through `onAction`, and draw your app in the browser tab with `renderBrowserPage`. Each session plays a `script`, or shows a real harness: pass an `events` log, or a store from `createHarnessStore()` and push events as they happen. Sub-agents, messages between agents, handoffs, phases, shared tasks, worktrees, pull requests and CI checks are all events.
